resources.string: Welcome to MediaSync
Move photos and videos from your phones to one place, quickly and privately.
How will you use this phone?
This phone sends
Sends its photos and videos to your receiving phone.
This phone receives
Collects photos and videos from your other phones. Google Photos on it can back them up.
How it works
Choose one phone to receive. A phone that stays at home on a charger works best, such as an older Pixel.
Pair each sending phone with it once, by scanning a code.
New photos and videos go over every night while the phones charge, or right away with Sync now. They go straight from phone to phone, encrypted, with no account.
To change this phone's role later, choose Reset MediaSync in the ⋮ menu.
How will you use this computer?
This computer sends
Sends the photos and videos in the folders you choose to your receiving device.
This computer receives
Collects photos and videos from your phones and copies them to a folder you choose.
Choose one device to receive. A computer or phone that stays on and at home works best.
Pair each sending device with it once, by scanning its code or pasting its link.
New photos and videos go over on a schedule, or right away with Sync now. They go straight from device to device, encrypted, with no account.
To change this computer's role later, choose Reset MediaSync in the ⋮ menu; MediaSync closes, and asks again when you open it.
